policies.name: landing_page_versions_write
policies.check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM landing_pages p
  WHERE ((p.id = landing_page_versions.page_id) AND (is_agency_admin() OR ((p.client_account_id IS NOT NULL) AND (auth_role() = 'agency_staff'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM sub_account_assignments a
          WHERE ((a.sub_account_id = p.client_account_id) AND (a.user_id = auth.uid()) AND (a.role_in_account = ANY (ARRAY['account_manager'::text, 'marketing'::text])))))) OR ((p.client_account_id IS NOT NULL) AND (auth_role() = 'client_owner'::text) AND can_access_account(p.client_account_id) AND client_feature_enabled('client_page_editing'::text))))))

(wf_client_access(id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM wf_assignments

policies.name: screenshot_scope
policies.using:
((expires_at > now()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM wf_sessions s
  WHERE ((s.id = wf_screenshots.session_id) AND ((s.agent_id = auth.uid()) OR (wf_visible(s.agent_id, s.client_id, s.campaign_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM wf_clients c
          WHERE ((c.id = s.client_id) AND c.screenshots_enabled)))))))))

policies.name: workforce_user_read
policies.using:
((user_id = auth.uid()) OR ((wf_role() = 'client'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM wf_assignments a
  WHERE ((a.agent_id = wf_users.user_id) AND a.active AND wf_client_access(a.client_id))))))
